answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions 200 slots; each identity bids a locked deposit. The ledger is crystal clear: every bid is public, so no one can hide duplicates. Slots are priced like saffron: the winning deposit is two months' earnings, locked 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 6,000 POA in deposits for at most 3,000 POA of income. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted; a forged identity is willow wood, snapping under audit.
